patch_list: Convert IAP items to Star Bux

Converts real-money boots, Super NRG drinks, and Pro/Expert agents and trainers into Star Bux purchases in both modern and classic UI, and replaces the dead Buy Bux redirect with an in-game insufficient-funds banner.
Disable ads
Blocks AdMob and DT Exchange/Fyber interstitial ads, removes the built-in promo interstitial, and hides the promotional "Games we like" button while keeping opt-in rewarded videos.
Disable analytics and tracking
Disables Firebase Analytics, Flurry analytics and startup measurement, and removes Advertising ID permissions.
Disable Google Play Games
Disables broken Google Play Games auto-sign-in on re-signed APKs and hides the dead Play Games button on the Career screen (modern and classic UI).
Disable remote config and cloud overrides
Freezes the in-game Cloud/DLC/Cohort override system so remote updates and cached DLC files can never overwrite local patched assets or TweakValues, and speeds up startup.
Disable retention notifications
Prevents the game from scheduling local "come back and play" reminder notifications whenever it goes to the background.
Enhanced replays and MP4/GIF export
Adds a Replay Studio button during goal replays to customize playback speed, loop, slow-mo overlays, all-chance replays, and export clean HUD-free MP4 videos or animated GIFs.
Fix text input backspace
Fixes backspace when typing names in the game by using the in-game keyboard, which has a working delete button.
Retro season selector
Prompts to choose a historical club database (2011–2026) bundled in the APK whenever you start a new career. Existing careers are unaffected.
Save backup and restore
Adds a Backup button to the Career screen (modern and classic UI) to export and restore your full save via the system file picker, with automatic rollback protection.
Unlock Pro features
Unlocks the Pro license, ad removal, pitches/weather and special balls by setting the local license flags the game checks.
